necessary_context.content: D subset R^s, x in R^p, f(lambda)=g(X(lambda),lambda), X(lambda) in argmin_x h(x,lambda). Vector norms are Euclidean. Write H=∇²_11 h in R^(p×p), B=∇²_12 h in R^(p×s), a=∇_1 g and c=∇_2 g. Equation (2) gives ∇f=c-B^T H^(-1)a at (X(lambda),lambda) when the differentiable implicit solution is applicable.

necessary_context.content: A1: first derivatives of g and second derivatives of h are Lipschitz continuous. A2: H(X(lambda),lambda) is invertible for every lambda in D; invertibility throughout the whole ambient domain is not required. A3: D is nonempty, convex and compact. These written assumptions alone are not recorded as establishing a globally consistent smooth minimizer selection when multiple branches exist.
